subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word to fill in the blank.

Averted

Rohit _______ looking at Sheena's face while we were talking about domestic violence.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Avoided**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"averted"** means to turn away or to prevent something from happening. (टालना)
 
 
• **Example: **The quick actions of the driver averted a major accident.
 
 
 
• **"Avoided" **means to keep away from or stop oneself from doing something. (बचना)
 
 
• **Example: **She avoided eye contact during the entire meeting.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct synonym for "averted" in this context is "avoided".
